UI_Prepackaged_CurrentUpdate: In use: %1, version %2. Version %3 is ready: select it and press Update.
UI_Prepackaged_CurrentGone: In use: %1, version %2. Its pack file is no longer found.
UI_Prepackaged_StatusDefaults: %1 %2 of the pack's key binds and mod options wait for you: press Defaults.
UI_Prepackaged_ClipboardHow: Copy the text of a pack file, then press Paste a pack.
UI_Prepackaged_AlreadyListed: This pack is already in the list.
UI_Prepackaged_NoPacks: No packs found. Subscribe to a pack on the Workshop, put a pack file in Zomboid/Lua/Prepackaged/packs, or copy the text of a pack file and press Paste a pack.
UI_Prepackaged_SourceClipboard: Pasted, kept as a file once used
UI_Prepackaged_DetailUnplaced: Key binds and mod options the game as loaded now can't place (%1): their mod isn't enabled, or a typo
UI_Prepackaged_UseNewer: A newer version of the pack in use: %1, while %2 is in use.
UI_Prepackaged_UseOlder: An older version of the pack in use: %1, while %2 is in use.
UI_Prepackaged_DetailErrors: Errors (%1): the pack can't be used until its author fixes them.
UI_Prepackaged_TickUnavailable: %1, can't be used: the game version doesn't fit or a mod it needs is missing
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewDowngrade: Go back to version %3 of %1, from version %2
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewMissingCount: %1 of the pack's %2 mods aren't installed, so your mod list will be incomplete.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewSubscribe: Subscribe to them on the Workshop first. A helper that subscribes for you comes in a later version.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewCollection: The pack's collection is Workshop item %1.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewOptional: Optional mods (%1): tick the ones you want
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewUnavailable: Can't be used, left out (%1): the game version doesn't fit or a mod they need is missing
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewRequired: Added before the mods that need them: %1.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewConflicts: The pack's order goes against these mods' own load order rules (the pack's order is used)
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewOwnConflicts: Your own mods stay after the pack's mods, in your order, which goes against these mods' own load order rules
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewOrder: The load order changes to the pack's order.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewOwnMods: Using a pack replaces your mod list. Add your own mods afterwards in the Mods screen: updates of this pack keep them.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewNoChange: Your mod list already matches. Apply only remembers the pack.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewMapOrder: The map order becomes the pack's: %1.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewMapOrderCleared: Your map order is cleared, so the game orders the maps by the new mod list.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewBackup: Your mod list in use now is backed up first, in its exact load order and with its map order. Restore in the Prepackaged window brings it back.
UI_Prepackaged_ReviewReload: The game reloads its mods after Apply.
UI_Prepackaged_PresetPrompt: Save this mod list as the preset:
UI_Prepackaged_PresetSaved: Saved as the Mods screen preset "%1". Mods screen presets keep the mods, not their load order.
UI_Prepackaged_PresetFailed: The preset couldn't be saved. Your presets file from before is copied in Zomboid/Lua/%1.
UI_Prepackaged_AskIncomplete: %1 of the pack's %2 mods can't be enabled: they aren't installed or can't be used.
UI_Prepackaged_AskApplyAnyway: Your mod list will be incomplete. Apply anyway?
UI_Prepackaged_AskReplace: Zomboid/Lua/%1 already holds another pack file.
UI_Prepackaged_AskReplaceVersions: It has version %1, the pasted pack has version %2. Replace it?
UI_Prepackaged_FailNewer: Zomboid/Lua/%1 was written by a newer Prepackaged, so nothing was changed. Update Prepackaged first.
UI_Prepackaged_FailBackup: Your mod list couldn't be backed up to Zomboid/Lua/%1, so nothing was changed.
UI_Prepackaged_FailPackFile: The pasted pack couldn't be saved in Zomboid/Lua/%1, so your mod list wasn't changed.
UI_Prepackaged_FailState: Zomboid/Lua/%1 couldn't be saved, so your mod list wasn't changed.
UI_Prepackaged_RestoreKept: Your mod lists, key binds and mod options from before each change, newest first: the first of each for good, and the newest %1 of the others.
UI_Prepackaged_NoBackups: No backups yet. Prepackaged backs up your mod list, key binds and mod options before it changes them.
UI_Prepackaged_RestorePack: After the restore, the pack in use is %1, version %2, as it was then.
UI_Prepackaged_RestoreNoPack: After the restore, no pack is in use, as it was then.
UI_Prepackaged_RestoreWithout: Prepackaged isn't in this list, so it won't be enabled after the restore. Enable it in the Mods screen to use it again.
UI_Prepackaged_RestoreBackup: Your mod list in use now is backed up first. The game reloads its mods when they change.
UI_Prepackaged_AskRestore: Restore this list of %1 mods, in its exact order?
UI_Prepackaged_AskRestoreBackup: Your mod list in use now is backed up first.
UI_Prepackaged_AskRestoreFiles: Put back these key binds and mod options?
UI_Prepackaged_AskRestoreFilesBackup: Your key binds and mod options now are backed up first.
UI_Prepackaged_FilesFirst: Your key binds and mod options before Prepackaged
UI_Prepackaged_FilesBeforePack: Key binds and mod options before the defaults of %1, version %2
UI_Prepackaged_FilesBeforeRestore: Key binds and mod options before restoring backup %1
UI_Prepackaged_FilesDetail: Backup %1, %2, key binds and mod options
UI_Prepackaged_FilesRestore: Your key binds and mod options now are backed up first. Then the game reloads its mods, so the options screen reads both files again.
UI_Prepackaged_FailFilesBackup: Your key binds and mod options couldn't be backed up to Zomboid/Lua/%1, so nothing was changed.
UI_Prepackaged_FailRestoreFile: Zomboid/Lua/%1 couldn't be written. Your key binds and mod options from just before are in backup %2: restore that one.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsSubtitle: The pack's suggested values. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsIntro: Ticked rows change when you press Apply. The others keep your value, and Prepackaged asks about them again only when the pack changes them. A tick starts on where you have the game's default or what Prepackaged set before. Your key binds and mod options are backed up first, and Restore in the Prepackaged window brings them back.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsFeatureKeys: The game has no %1 any more, so the pack's key binds wait until Prepackaged is updated.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsFeatureOptions: The game has no %1 any more, so the pack's mod options wait until Prepackaged is updated.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsClashes: Keys used by more than one action after these changes (%1)
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsInvalid: Can't be used (%1): the pack's author can fix these
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsWaiting: Waiting (%1): tried again each time the game starts
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsServer: Set by the server (%1), so left as they are
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsDecided: %1 you decided on before aren't shown: Show all entries lists them.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsRestart: Some mods read their options only when the game starts: if a change doesn't show, restart the game.
UI_Prepackaged_DefaultsDone: Changed %1 key binds and mod options. Restore puts back the ones from before.
UI_Prepackaged_FailDefaultsState: The changes are made, but Zomboid/Lua/%1 couldn't be saved, so Prepackaged doesn't remember your answers and may ask again.
UI_Prepackaged_FailDefaultsWrite: %1 of the changes didn't read back from the game's files, so Prepackaged will ask about them again. Your key binds and mod options from before are in backup %2.
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_NotLoaded: %1: no mod that is loaded has it
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_NoOption: %1: the mod has no such option
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_Feature: %1: the game has no %2 any more
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_Type: %1: the pack gives a %2 value, but the option is a %3
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_Count: %1: the pack gives %2 ticks, but the option has %3
UI_Prepackaged_Reason_NotRead: %1: its mod makes it after the game reads ModOptions.ini, so Prepackaged can't see your value
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadLine: This line doesn't fit the format of its section and is skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_UnknownSection: Unknown section %1: its lines are skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_OutsideSection: This line comes before any section and is skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_RepeatedKey: %1 is set again; the first value is kept.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadId: The id "%1" must be 1 to 48 letters, digits, _ or -.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadVersion: The version "%1" must be a whole number from 1.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadWorkshopId: "%1" is not a Workshop ID, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadModId: "%1" is not a mod ID, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadNumber: %1 must be a whole number from 1, not "%2".
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_OptionalInMods: %1 is in Mods already, so it isn't optional.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_CollectionCycle: Collection %1 lists %2, which leads back to it.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadKeyPart: "%1" is not part of a key bind, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadKey: The key bind %1 has no key, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_TooManyFields: This line has more than 4 fields, and values can't contain |. Skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadSandboxName: "%1" is not a sandbox option name, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_BadLock: "%1" is not a Page or Page.option entry, skipped.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_NotFirst: Put %1 first in Mods: mods that load before it can make a player's own mod options look like defaults, and their key binds like the game's own.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_TooBig: This file is too big: a pack file can have up to %1 lines and %2 characters.
UI_Prepackaged_Diag_LineTooLong: This line is longer than %1 characters.
